title: DraftAttention: Fast Video Diffusion via Low-Resolution Attention Guidance
original_abstract: Diffusion transformer–based video generation models (DiTs) have recently attracted widespread attention for their excellent generation quality. However, their computational cost remains a major bottleneck—attention alone accounts for over 80% of total latency, and generating just 8 seconds of 720p video takes tens of minutes—posing serious challenges to practical application and scalability. To address this, we propose the DraftAttention, a training-free framework for the acceleration of video diffusion transformers with dynamic sparse attention on GPUs. We apply down-sampling to each feature map across frames in the compressed latent space, enabling a higher-level receptive field over the latent composed of hundreds of thousands of tokens. The low-resolution draft attention map, derived from draft query and key, exposes redundancy both spatially within each feature map and temporally across frames. We reorder the query, key, and value based on the draft attention map to guide the sparse attention computation in full resolution, and subsequently restore their original order after the attention computation. This reordering enables structured sparsity that aligns with hardware-optimized execution. Our theoretical analysis demonstrates that the low-resolution draft attention closely approximates the full attention, providing reliable guidance for constructing accurate sparse attention. Experimental results show that our method outperforms existing sparse attention approaches in video generation quality and achieves up to 1.75× end-to-end speedup on GPUs.

innovative_points.description: Introduces a novel training-free approach that dynamically generates sparse attention patterns for each attention module without requiring model retraining or fine-tuning
innovative_points.runtime_change: [n, d, n] → [n, d, r*n] where r is the sparsity ratio
innovative_points.benefit: Plug-and-play acceleration with no quality degradation from retraining

innovative_points.description: Uses 8×16 average pooling to create low-resolution draft attention maps that capture high-level spatial-temporal patterns with 128× token reduction
innovative_points.runtime_change: [n, d, n] → [n/128, d, n/128] for draft + [n, d, r*n] for sparse
innovative_points.benefit: O(n²/128²) computation for guidance vs O(n²) for full attention

innovative_points.description: Deterministic reordering algorithm that groups 8×16 spatial patches into contiguous memory blocks for efficient GPU execution
innovative_points.runtime_change: Scattered memory access → Coalesced block access
innovative_points.benefit: Enables efficient block sparse attention kernels and reduces memory latency

innovative_points.description: Provides formal Frobenius-norm bounds for both draft attention approximation error (||S-S_draft||_F ≤ δn) and sparsity masking error (||S-S⊙M||_F ≤ n(δ+t)√(1-r))
Leverages pooling to create broader receptive fields that capture both local details and global context in video sequences
innovative_points.benefit: Better preservation of both fine details and global structure

baseline_method.name: Full Attention (Dense)
baseline_method.complexity: O(n²d) where n=614K tokens for 768p video

improvements.name: Adaptive Pooling Strategy
improvements.description: Content-aware pooling kernel sizes based on motion vectors and saliency maps
improvements.implementation: Real-time motion analysis to adjust 4×4 to 16×16 kernels

improvements.name: Dynamic Sparsity Controller
improvements.description: RL-based controller that predicts optimal sparsity per frame/region
improvements.implementation: Small neural network (<1M parameters) for sparsity prediction

improvements.name: Multi-Scale Draft Attention
improvements.implementation: Multi-level draft maps with learned fusion

improvements.name: Quantization Integration
improvements.description: INT8/INT4 quantization combined with sparsity using SVDQuant

improvements.name: Temporal Gating Mechanism
improvements.description: LSTM-based frame importance scoring to skip unimportant frames

improvements.name: Learnable Draft Attention
improvements.description: Replace fixed pooling with learnable 1×1 convolutions

improvements.name: Attention Cascade
improvements.description: Three-stage refinement: ultra-low → medium → selective full

improvements.name: Semantic-Aware Sparsity
improvements.description: Use semantic segmentation to guide object-aware sparsity
